subject: Renewal kickoff: term revision, throughput bump, and QBR window
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mori <alex.mori@signalworks.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: term revision, throughput bump, and QBR window

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the productive sync last week. This thread is to kick off the renewal and expansion work for SignalWorks (DEAL-4832). High level asks and plan below — goal is to lock term language and an operational cadence so your team has runway for the increased throughput in Q4.

Top-level asks (please confirm by Tue):
- Confirm desired term change: move from 12-month to 18-month (with standard staircase billing) — are you comfortable with that?
- Confirm throughput bump target: +25% token throughput starting 2027-10-01 (we've attached an initial estimate).
- Please propose 2x 60-minute QBR slots next week for an official handoff and SLA review. We want a cross-functional QBR with Product/Infra + your Eng/Delivery.

Proposed timeline (draft):
- Week 1 (this week): mutual action plan + draft SLA and term redline shared
- Week 2: legal & procurement review; technical pre-QBR (1:1) to validate sizing
- Week 3: formal QBR + signoff; implement capacity change in staging

I've attached a mutual action plan and a draft SLA. Kar is on deck for commercial/terms; Laura will coordinate legal redlines; Stephanie will lead the QBR agenda and ops runbook.

Next steps for Alex/Priya: share two available 60-min windows for next Wed/Thu (ET preferred) and confirm the +25% throughput target.

Thanks — look forward to closing this out smoothly.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0198

Attachments: SignalWorks_mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx, Redwood_SLA_draft_v2.pdf
From: Alex Mori <alex.mori@signalworks.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@signalworks.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: term revision, throughput bump, and QBR window

Jonas — thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Term: 18-month looks good from our side; procurement will need to see final language but we're aligned on the preference.
- Throughput: +25% target is the right ballpark; we'll need a short runbook for traffic shaping during the ramp.

QBR availability (ET):
- Wed 2027-06-09: 11:00–12:00 ET (preferred)
- Thu 2027-06-10: 09:00–10:00 ET

Two asks from SignalWorks before QBR:
1) A short SOW addendum and T&Cs estimate for the throughput increase and 18-month term.
2) A short pre-QBR tech call (30m) with your infra lead to validate KV cache behavior under our prefix patterns.

I can loop in our Delivery lead after we confirm a slot.

—Alex
Alex Mori
Head of Platform Engineering | SignalWorks
alex.mori@signalworks.com
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mori <alex.mori@signalworks.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: term revision, throughput bump, and QBR window

Alex — appreciate the quick reply. I'll own the commercial SOW addendum and will send a pricing summary by EOD Tue. Laura, can your team prepare an initial term redline we can share with SignalWorks procurement?

Jonas, I can take the pre-QBR tech call — proposing Tue 2027-06-08 14:00–14:30 PT which should be 17:00–17:30 ET. If that works for SignalWorks, I'll get an invite out.

Notes on sizing: the attached throughput_estimate_25pct.xlsx has two rollout options: immediate scale (fast path) or staged (two-step over 8 weeks). We'll propose the staged approach as default unless you indicate otherwise.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions & GTM | Redwood Inference

Hi Priya / Alex —

Following up on Kar's note — our legal team will prepare a redline focused on term length, data retention, and liability caps; expect a first pass by Tue EOD (we'll send as a tracked Word doc). A couple of items you'll likely see:
- Standard SLA metrics and remedies (we can discuss during the QBR)
- Option to include an early termination credit tied to usage commitments

If SignalWorks procurement prefers a DocuSign workflow, flag that now and we'll route the redline accordingly.

Thanks — Laura

We'll await the pricing addendum and legal redline. Priya will join the pre-QBR call and bring our Delivery lead. See you then.

Alex
